title: Resumed positions can trigger exits before the exit-worker watchdog is installed, so those first exits run unbounded

evidence.note: installExitWatchdog runs only after the listeners and Telegram start
until then the worker uses identityWatchdog (no bound); drain reads this.watchdog per item (:1399)

sibling_sites_checked: The only watchdog install site (bot.ts:2177-2182) and the boot order around it. Resumed positions older than 30 minutes fire the urgency exit on their first good tick, 5 s after resume, which is likely before :1879 when the anti-rug backfill is slow.
severity_rationale: S3: the order is a code fact; the effect is a liveness bound missing for the first boot-time exits only.
recommendation: Install the watchdog before any monitor is armed. Card EXIT-04 (no trading-rule change, only ordering). Phase 29.
